item.title: Futari Gurashi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Himemiya Yuuhi
  • 発売日: 2008-10-11
  • スコア: 6.590000000000001/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふたりぐらし
  • 英語名: Futari Gurashi

あらすじ

This is a love story about living together with your niece.

The couple’s story starts in a normal, mundane town that you could find anywhere.

They spend their days together and eventually become attracted to each other.

But each of them has a wound from the past that keeps them from getting closer to each other.
